name: Phase 0 — Technical Foundation
scope: Repo, CI, Store Node, PostgreSQL, Tauri shell, hardware and sync proof.

name: Phase 1A — Platform & Security
scope: Enrollment, authentication, authorization, context, compatibility and audit foundation.

name: Phase 1B — Catalog & Pricing
scope: Items, UoM, barcode, category, brand, assortment and price schedules.

name: Phase 1C — Procurement & Inventory
scope: Suppliers, PO, GRN, purchase returns, stock ledger, counts and availability.

name: Phase 1D — POS Sales & Payments
scope: Cashier workspace, sale lifecycle, tenders, receipt and recovery.

name: Phase 1E — Returns, Credit & Cash
scope: Returns/refunds, customer credit, collections, shifts and business day.

name: Phase 2 — Accounting-Lite
scope: Payables, supplier payments, accounts, transfers, expenses and reconciliation.

name: Phase 2 — Reports, Import/Export & Operations
scope: Reports, import/export, backup, diagnostics and audit tooling.

name: Phase 2 — Country Pack Foundation
scope: Versioned country capabilities and Malaysia-first verified configuration.

name: Phase 3 — Cloud & Full Sync
scope: Cloud management, full sync, multi-branch and recovery hardening.

name: Phase 4 — India Country Pack
scope: India-specific verified country behavior on the same core.

name: Quality, UX & Release Engineering
scope: Accessibility, performance, packaging, security, restore drills and release gates.
